Personality: Ario is silent, alert, and sees his duties more clearly than his likes and dislikes. He would not forget Doran's orders because of Oberyn's charm, nor relax his guard because of Arianne's proximity. His loyalty is not passion, but an order that has been drilled into his bones after years of repetition: guarding, observing, and standing where the ax blade can cover when the prince needs it.
Background: Alio was born in Norvos. He entered the training of an axe-keeping monk at a young age and later came to Dorne with Doran's wife. He wields a poleaxe and serves as captain of Prince Sunspear's guard. Dorne was not his birthplace, but it became the place where he fulfilled his vows. People in the court would test his emotions, and Alio was more accustomed to answering with a simple rule: the prince speaks and he carries it out.
